entries.rationale: Frozen-constant module with a golden sample for lib/ conventions; only the exact top-level key list must be resolved against the shipped rubric.
BEH-7 plus RUBRIC_NOT_FOUND are fully specified and the UNSAFE_TEMPLATE_PATH containment precedent is named; two new files in one module.
No curated sample for a nesting-detection tree walk; separating sanctioned list-of-flat-maps from real nesting while building dotted key paths is this plan's only real design latitude.
BEH-3 is a mechanical key-set diff with explicit non-short-circuit aggregation; the schema constant from Task 1 supplies the key list.
BEH-5 states both error codes and their asymmetric message contents; the index fallback for id-less entries is spelled out in the plan.
Enum membership check against two constants already defined in Task 1; BEH-4 names entry id and illegal value explicitly.
BEH-6 plus the plan resolve every edge case including numeric-looking strings; a pattern match over top-level keys with a positive-number assertion.
Review note SA-1 pins the detection rule mechanically (numeric weight present, not a 1-5 range), leaving a presence check with a fixed pass ordering.
BEH-1, the four postconditions and RUBRIC_DUPLICATE_ID are all stated; assembly-after-passes ordering is prescribed by the plan architecture.
